definition.label: SR-57 Imperial Highway - screenshot foreground carriageway after pan
definition.notes: Camera panned on 4 November 2026. Count only the finite screenshot-aligned line across the foreground main carriageway, from the median to the near shoulder. Exclude opposing traffic beyond the median, the separate far-left loop and the right slip road before tracking. Only a confirmed bottom-centre crossing in capture UTC counts, once per vehicle; detection or road-mask entry alone never counts. Existing published rounds retain their frozen definitions and all timing, coverage, framing and tracking checks.
